regions.text: たが寫眞師はどうしてもフイルムを渡さなかつた。細君はひどく失望したさうです。

quote.translation: A few days before the outbreak of war her husband, who had gone to Strassburg, called in at the shop and explained that, though he had no receipt, he was so-and-so and had left a film to be developed, but the photographer would not hand the film over on any account, and his wife, it seems, was bitterly disappointed.

regions.text: それつ切りになつてゐる中に一九一六年になつて、細君がだしかフランクフルトだつたと思ひますがブイルムを一つ買つてゾオデンといふ温泉場へ持て行てそこで生れて一年半になる女の見の寫真を取つた。

quote.translation: Things stayed like that until 1916, when the wife bought a film, in Frankfurt, I think, took it with her to a spa called Soden, and there photographed their daughter, then a year and a half old.

regions.text: それを現像させてみると皆だぷつてるるといふ事が分つた。

quote.translation: When she had it developed, every picture turned out to be double-exposed.

regions.text: そんな筈は無いがとフィルムを翳してよく見ると、驚いた事には膝朧として夢の様に長男の姿がシュワルッワルドの雪を背景にして現ばれた。

quote.translation: Thinking that could not be, she held the film up to the light and looked closely, and to her astonishment the figure of her eldest son appeared, hazy, like a dream, against the snow of the Schwarzwald.

regions.text: それと重なり合つて妹の縮れ髪の日光浴をしてゐろ裸かの姿が見える、兄妹がフィルムの中で一つになつてゐた。

quote.translation: Overlapping it could be seen the naked figure of his curly-haired little sister sunbathing; brother and sister had become one in the film.

regions.text: この偶然に對する解釋は「取争のどさくさ粉れに前の寫兵師が次の寫真師にフイルムをごつちゃにして賣つたのだ。或はその間に第三者が介してるたかも知れないが』といふのであるが、「何の氣無しにその店

quote.translation: The explanation offered for this chance is that "in the confusion of the war the first photographer sold the film, mixed up with others, to the next photographer, or perhaps a third party came in between".

regions.text: へ行つて、「一足おそけれは他の人が買つてしまつたかも知れないー丁度にまたぞのフィルムが手に入つた』ことに大きい偶然がある（成無極、偶然間答四五一ー四五二頁、WilhemvonScholz，DerZulal,1924,S21-2）。

quote.translation: Yet the great chance lies in this, that "going to the shop without a second thought (a step later and someone else might have bought it), she came by that very film just at the right time" (Naruse Mukyoku, Dialogue on Chance, pp. 451-452, Wilhelm von Scholz, Der Zufall, 1924, S. 21-24).

regions.text: この偶然の中に含まれてゐる可能性は極度に小さく殆ど

quote.translation: The possibility contained in this chance is extremely small, almost equal to the impossible, and the contingency is consequently extremely great.
